verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline-over-tagline hierarchy and a clean text block, but both framing rules are gone from the text: one has landed as a stray black line across the cup and box in the photo, and the bottom rule is missing, so the bracket motif is broken and there's an obvious artifact. B flips the hierarchy: 'Order online' shrinks to small text while 'food & drinks' becomes the largest element and runs over the takeout box ('drinks' collides with busy imagery). The two rules also float far above and below the tiny headline, leaving a lot of empty space.
